name: _DYNAMIC
reason: dynamic section, written by ld.so before main

name: completed.*
reason: crt guard of the global destructors

name: init_mimalloc_entry
reason: .preinit_array entry that starts mimalloc; never written

name: recurse
reason: mimalloc per-thread recursion guard (options.c); its TLS symbol has no line

name: lu_exc_*
reason: exception type behind a PyExc_* pointer; the kernel fills in its slots once at startup

name: lu_inittab
reason: empty PyImport_Inittab terminator; replaced when the kernel registers builtin modules

name: lu_exception_types
reason: const table of the exception types; relocated by ld.so, then read-only (RELRO)

name: lu_frozen_kernel
reason: const table of the frozen kernel; relocated by ld.so, then read-only (RELRO)

name: targets.*
reason: const dispatch table of label addresses; relocated by ld.so, then read-only (RELRO)

name: lucifer_methods
reason: _lucifer's PyMethodDef table, never written; the API takes it non-const

name: lucifer_slots
reason: _lucifer's PyModuleDef_Slot table, never written; the API takes it non-const

name: lu_lucifer_module
reason: _lucifer's PyModuleDef, never written; one per process, as every extension's def
